correctness.rationale: All Borel turning laws are covered by the exact angular path-KL rate. Symmetrization gives the first moment constraints, Cauchy-Schwarz and strict convexity establish the universal inequality; the two-angle optimizer attains it and the cosine variance equality condition proves its uniqueness for nonzero chirality. Smooth exact-moment approximants and unit-circle endpoints are proved. The 318 program checks corroborate finite instances, not the universal measure statement.

value.rationale: The result solves the natural sharp joint persistence/chirality constrained dissipation problem for arbitrary Poisson angular reorientation laws. It yields an exact minimal angular irreversibility and unique optimal turning strategy measurable through the first angular harmonic, plus a divergent threshold at the extreme kinematic boundary. These are physically interpretable structural facts, not an arbitrary slice or a restatement of a generic KL formula.
